+    report = ReconciliationReport(mode="online-5-category", passed=True)
+    if mc_sum.errors or th_sum.errors:
+        report.passed = False
+        report.diagnostics.extend(mc_sum.errors + th_sum.errors)
+    if mc_sum.max_drop > 0 or mc_sum.max_trunc > 0 or th_sum.max_drop > 0 or th_sum.max_trunc > 0:

+def http_request_json(url: str, method: str = "GET", payload: Optional[bytes] = None) -> Tuple[int, Dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Perform an HTTP GET or POST request and return (status_code, parsed_json)."""
+    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=payload, method=method)
+    if payload is not None:
+        req.add_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
+    try:
+        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=3.0) as resp:
+            raw = resp.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+            return resp.status, (json.loads(raw) if raw.strip() else {})
+    except urllib.error.HTTPError as err:
+        raw = err.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+        try:
+            body = json.loads(raw) if raw.strip() else {}
+        except ValueError:
+            body = {"raw_error": raw}
+        return err.code, body
